requirements.title: Baseline RBAC with Admin and User Roles Enforced on Management Endpoints
requirements.description: The service must define at minimum two built-in roles: 'admin' and 'user'. Role assignments are stored in SQLite and emitted as a roles claim in issued JWTs so relying parties can consume them without calling back. Management endpoints (user list, role assignment, session admin, audit log query) must require the admin role. User endpoints require the user role. Role enforcement must occur at the RPC handler layer.
